claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Lomerizine is a calcium channel blocker with no reported cytotoxic or antiproliferative activity at micromolar concentrations; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen, with any weak effects reflecting non-specific ion channel modulation rather than a cytotoxic mechanism.
